# instanode.dev

instanode.dev is a zero-setup infrastructure provisioning API for developers and AI coding agents. Provision real, working infrastructure — databases, caches, queues, and full app stacks — with a single HTTP call. No account required. No Docker. No configuration.

Resources are provisioned anonymously (24h expiry) or permanently (with an account). Connection strings use standard protocols (postgres://, redis://, mongodb://, nats://) so any standard client library works directly. No SDK required.

## Base URL

https://instanode.dev

## Authentication

No auth required for anonymous provisioning. For permanent resources, pass a Bearer session JWT:
  Authorization: Bearer <session_jwt>

Session JWTs are issued by /auth/github, /auth/google, or the CLI device flow (/auth/cli).
JWT expiry: 24 hours.

Unauthenticated requests fall back to anonymous tier automatically — no error.

---

## MCP Server (Claude Code / AI agents)

Install once globally:
  npx @instant/mcp

Or add to Claude Code settings:
  { "mcpServers": { "instant": { "command": "npx", "args": ["@instant/mcp"] } } }

Available MCP tools:
  provision_database     — calls POST /db/new
  provision_cache        — calls POST /cache/new
  provision_document_db  — calls POST /nosql/new
  provision_queue        — calls POST /queue/new
  deploy_stack           — calls POST /stacks/new
  list_my_resources      — calls GET /api/v1/resources (requires auth)

---

## Provisioning Endpoints (Live)

All provisioning endpoints:
- Accept optional body: { "name": "..." }
- Return: id, token, name, connection_url, tier, limits, note
- Anonymous: resources expire in 24h, 5 provisions/day per IP fingerprint
- Authenticated: resources are permanent

### POST /db/new

Provision a Postgres database (includes pgvector extension).

Request body (application/json): `{ "name": "my-app-db" }`. `name` is required — 1–64 chars matching `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9 _-]*$`. Omitting it returns HTTP 400.

Response 201:
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "id": "d290f1ee-6c54-4b01-90e6-d701748f0851",
  "token": "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890",
  "name": "my-app-db",
  "connection_url": "postgres://usr_a1b2c3d4:pass_a1b2c3d4@shared.instanode.dev/db_a1b2c3d4",
  "tier": "anonymous",
  "limits": { "storage_mb": 10, "connections": 2, "expires_in": "24h" },
  "note": "Works now. Free forever with a free account: https://instanode.dev/start?t=<jwt>"
}
```

connection_url works with any standard postgres driver (psycopg2, pg, database/sql, ActiveRecord, Prisma).
pgvector extension is pre-installed — CREATE EXTENSION vector; works immediately.

Tier limits:
- anonymous: 10MB storage, 2 connections, 24h TTL
- hobby: 500MB storage, 5 connections, permanent
- pro: 5120MB storage, 20 connections, permanent
- team: unlimited, permanent

### POST /cache/new

Provision a Redis cache (ACL-isolated namespace).

Request body (application/json): `{ "name": "session-cache" }`. `name` is required — 1–64 chars matching `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9 _-]*$`. Omitting it returns HTTP 400.

Response 201:
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "id": "e5f6a7b8-c9d0-1234-efab-567890abcdef",
  "token": "b2c3d4e5-f6a7-8901-bcde-f12345678901",
  "name": "session-cache",
  "connection_url": "redis://:pass_b2c3d4e5@shared.instanode.dev:6379/0",
  "tier": "anonymous",
  "limits": { "memory_mb": 5, "expires_in": "24h" },
  "note": "Works now. Free forever with a free account: https://instanode.dev/start?t=<jwt>"
}
```

connection_url works with any standard redis client (redis-py, ioredis, go-redis).

Tier limits:
- anonymous: 5MB memory
- hobby: 25MB memory
- pro: 256MB memory
- team: unlimited

### POST /nosql/new

Provision a MongoDB database.

Request body (application/json): `{ "name": "events-db" }`. `name` is required — 1–64 chars matching `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9 _-]*$`. Omitting it returns HTTP 400.

Response 201:
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "id": "f6a7b8c9-d0e1-2345-fab0-678901abcdef",
  "token": "c3d4e5f6-a7b8-9012-cdef-012345678902",
  "name": "events-db",
  "connection_url": "mongodb://usr_c3d4e5f6:pass_c3d4e5f6@shared.instanode.dev:27017/db_c3d4e5f6",
  "tier": "anonymous",
  "limits": { "storage_mb": 5, "connections": 2, "expires_in": "24h" },
  "note": "Works now. Free forever with a free account: https://instanode.dev/start?t=<jwt>"
}
```

connection_url works with any standard MongoDB driver (pymongo, mongoose, mongo-driver).

Tier limits:
- anonymous: 5MB storage, 2 connections
- hobby: 100MB storage, 5 connections
- pro: 2048MB storage, 20 connections
- team: unlimited

### POST /queue/new

Provision a NATS JetStream message queue.

Request body (application/json): `{ "name": "task-queue" }`. `name` is required — 1–64 chars matching `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9 _-]*$`. Omitting it returns HTTP 400.

Response 201:
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "id": "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890",
  "token": "d4e5f6a7-b8c9-0123-def0-123456789012",
  "name": "task-queue",
  "connection_url": "nats://usr_d4e5f6a7:deadbeef0123456789abcdef01234567@nats.instanode.dev:4222",
  "tier": "anonymous",
  "limits": { "storage_mb": 1024, "expires_in": "24h" },
  "note": "Works now. Free forever with a free account: https://instanode.dev/start?t=<jwt>"
}
```

connection_url works with any standard NATS client (nats.go, nats.js, nats.py).

## Phase 6 (Live): App Stack Deployment

Deploy a full application stack from a Dockerfile. Multipart POST.

### POST /stacks/new

Deploy a new app stack. Accepts a multipart/form-data body.

Fields:
- name (string, required): 1–64 chars matching ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9 _-]*$. Omitting it returns HTTP 400.
- manifest (file, required): YAML manifest file (instant.yaml). Defines services and build config.
- <service-name> (file, per service): gzipped tarball of the service source directory.

Manifest format (instant.yaml):
```yaml
services:
  web:
    build: .
    port: 80
    expose: true
  api:
    build: ./api
    port: 8080
    expose: false
    env:
      LOG_LEVEL: debug
      DB_URL: service://postgres
```

- expose: true → service receives a public URL
- expose: false → service is only reachable by other services in the same stack
- env values prefixed service:// → resolved at deploy time to http://<service-name>:<port> (internal ClusterIP DNS of another service in the SAME manifest, not external resources)

Example request:
```bash
curl -X POST https://instanode.dev/stacks/new \
  -F name=prod-stack \
  -F manifest=@instant.yaml \
  -F web=@web.tar.gz \
  -F api=@api.tar.gz
```

Response 202 (build started):
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "stack_id": "stk-7068b2a1",
  "status": "building",
  "tier": "anonymous",
  "expires_in": "24h",
  "note": "Stack is building. Poll GET /stacks/stk-7068b2a1 for status. Anonymous stacks expire in 24h."
}
```

The build runs asynchronously. Poll GET /stacks/:slug for status.

### GET /stacks/:slug

Get stack status and service URLs. Poll this after POST /stacks/new until status is "healthy" or "failed".

Response 200 (building):
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "stack_id": "stk-7068b2a1",
  "status": "building",
  "tier": "anonymous",
  "expires_in": "24h"
}
```

Response 200 (healthy):
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "stack_id": "stk-7068b2a1",
  "status": "healthy",
  "tier": "anonymous",
  "expires_at": "2026-04-11T05:03:40Z",
  "services": [
    { "name": "web", "status": "healthy", "url": "http://localhost:31036", "expose": true, "port": 80 },
    { "name": "api", "status": "healthy", "url": null, "expose": false, "port": 8080 }
  ]
}
```

Response 200 (failed):
```json
{
  "ok": false,
  "stack_id": "stk-7068b2a1",
  "status": "failed",
  "error": "build_failed",
  "message": "Docker build failed for service 'web': see /stacks/stk-7068b2a1/logs/web"
}
```

Status values: building, deploying, healthy, degraded, failed

### GET /stacks

List all stacks. Requires Bearer JWT.

Response 200:
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "total": 2,
  "items": [
    {
      "stack_id": "stk-7068b2a1",
      "status": "healthy",
      "tier": "hobby",
      "created_at": "2026-04-10T05:03:40Z",
      "services": ["web", "api"]
    }
  ]
}
```

### DELETE /stacks/:slug

Tear down the stack. Removes all services and resources in the stack.

Response 200:
  { "ok": true, "message": "Stack deleted" }

### PATCH /stacks/:slug/env

Update environment variables for a service. Changes take effect on the next redeploy.

Request body:
```json
{
  "service": "api",
  "env": { "LOG_LEVEL": "info", "FEATURE_FLAG": "true" }
}
```

Response 200:
  { "ok": true, "message": "Environment updated. Redeploy to apply." }

Requires Bearer JWT.

### POST /stacks/:slug/redeploy

Rebuild images and perform a rolling restart. Requires Bearer JWT.

Response 202:
  { "ok": true, "status": "building", "message": "Redeploy started." }

### GET /stacks/:slug/logs/:svc

Stream pod logs for a service. Returns newline-delimited log lines.

Response 200: text/plain, streamed.

Stack tier limits:
- anonymous: 1 active stack, 24h TTL
- hobby: 3 active stacks, permanent
- pro: 10 active stacks, permanent
- team: unlimited, permanent

---

## Webhook Endpoints (Live)

### POST /webhook/new

Provision a webhook receiver URL. Any service (GitHub, Stripe, your own apps) can POST to it.

Request body (application/json): `{ "name": "github-hook" }`. `name` is required — 1–64 chars matching `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9 _-]*$`. Omitting it returns HTTP 400.

Response 201:
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "id": "f7b8c9d0-e1f2-3456-abcd-ef1234567890",
  "token": "e5f6a7b8-c9d0-1234-efab-567890abcdef",
  "receive_url": "https://instanode.dev/webhook/receive/e5f6a7b8-c9d0-1234-efab-567890abcdef",
  "tier": "anonymous",
  "limits": { "requests_stored": 100, "expires_in": "24h" },
  "note": "Works now. Free forever with a free account: https://instanode.dev/start?t=<jwt>"
}
```

Token IS the credential — no auth needed to receive or list requests.

Tier limits for requests_stored: anonymous=100, hobby=1000, pro=10000, team=unlimited.

### POST /webhook/receive/:token

Receive an inbound webhook. Accepts any HTTP method, any content type.
Full request (headers + body) is stored and retrievable.

Response 200: { "ok": true }

### GET /api/v1/webhooks/:token/requests

List stored requests. No auth required (token is the credential).

Query params: limit (default 20), offset (default 0).

Response 200:
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "total": 3,
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "req-uuid",
      "received_at": "2026-04-14T10:00:00Z",
      "method": "POST",
      "headers": { "content-type": "application/json" },
      "body": "{\"event\": \"push\"}"
    }
  ]
}
```

---

## Storage Endpoints (Live)

### POST /storage/new

Provision an S3-compatible object storage bucket. Returns AWS-compatible credentials. Production backend is DigitalOcean Spaces (S3-compatible) in `nyc3`. Anonymous-tier buckets are auto-deleted at 24h by a bucket lifecycle rule enforced at the storage layer.

Request body (application/json): `{ "name": "user-uploads" }`. `name` is required — 1–64 chars matching `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9 _-]*$`. Omitting it returns HTTP 400.

Response 201:
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "id": "a9b0c1d2-e3f4-5678-abcd-ef1234567890",
  "token": "f6a7b8c9-d0e1-2345-fab0-678901abcdef",
  "name": "user-uploads",
  "connection_url": "https://storage.instanode.dev/f6a7b8c9/",
  "endpoint": "https://storage.instanode.dev",
  "access_key_id": "AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE",
  "secret_access_key": "wJalrXUtnFEMI/K7MDENG/bPxRfiCYEXAMPLEKEY",
  "prefix": "f6a7b8c9/",
  "tier": "anonymous",
  "limits": { "storage_mb": 10, "expires_in": "24h" },
  "note": "Works now. Free forever with a free account: https://instanode.dev/start?t=<jwt>"
}
```

Use endpoint + access_key_id + secret_access_key with any S3 client (boto3, @aws-sdk/client-s3, aws-sdk-go-v2).
All objects are scoped to prefix automatically. Use forcePathStyle: true.

Tier limits for storage_mb: anonymous=10, hobby=512, pro=10240, team=unlimited.

---

## Resource Logs (Live)

### GET /resources/:token/logs

Stream pod logs for a growth-tier resource. SSE format — one log line per event, terminated by data: [end].

Query params: tail (default 100, max 500).

Response 200: text/event-stream
```
data: 2026-04-14 10:22:01.123 UTC [1] LOG: database system is ready
data: 2026-04-14 10:22:05.456 UTC [42] LOG: connection received
data: [end]
```

Token IS the credential — no Bearer JWT needed. Growth tier only (returns 400 when the token is not eligible for log streaming).

---

## CLI Device-Flow Auth

### POST /auth/cli

Start a CLI login session. No auth required.

Request body (optional JSON):
  { "anon_tokens": ["uuid1", "uuid2"] }

anon_tokens: optional list of anonymous resource tokens to claim on login.

Response 201:
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "session_id": "a3f9e2b1c4d5...",
  "auth_url": "https://instanode.dev/login?cli_session=a3f9e2b1c4d5...",
  "expires_in": 600
}
```

Direct the user to open auth_url in their browser. Poll /auth/cli/:id until complete.

### GET /auth/cli/:id

Poll for login completion.

Response 202 (pending):
  { "ok": true, "pending": true }

Response 200 (complete):
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "api_key": "eyJ...",
  "email": "you@example.com",
  "tier": "hobby",
  "team_name": "acme",
  "claimed_tokens": ["a1b2c3d4-..."]
}
```

Response 404: session not found or expired (10 min TTL).
Session is single-use — expires after first successful poll.

### GET /auth/me

Get the current user's account info. Requires Bearer JWT.

Response 200:
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "user_id": "d290f1ee-...",
  "team_id": "f47ac10b-...",
  "tier": "hobby"
}
```

---

## Upgrade / Claim Flow

Every anonymous API response includes a note field with a signed upgrade URL:
  https://instanode.dev/start?t=<signed-jwt>

### GET /start?t={jwt}

Validate the onboarding JWT. Used by the upgrade landing page.

Response 200:
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "tokens": ["a1b2c3d4-..."],
  "resource_types": ["postgres"],
  "jti": "unique-jwt-id"
}
```

Response 401: JWT invalid/expired.
Response 409: JWT already claimed.

### POST /claim

Convert anonymous session to registered account. Transfers all anonymous tokens.

Request body:
```json
{
  "jwt": "eyJ...",
  "email": "you@example.com",
  "team_name": "acme"
}
```

Response 201:
  { "ok": true, "team_id": "uuid", "message": "Account created. Your resource tokens have been transferred." }

Response 409: JWT already claimed.
The onboarding JWT is single-use.

---

## Management API (requires Bearer JWT)

### GET /api/v1/resources

List all team resources.

Response 200:
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "total": 2,
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "d290f1ee-...",
      "token": "a1b2c3d4-...",
      "resource_type": "postgres",
      "tier": "hobby",
      "status": "active",
      "created_at": "2026-04-01T12:00:00Z",
      "name": "my-app-db"
    }
  ]
}
```

Optional fields (name, expires_at) omitted when not set.
expires_at only present for anonymous-tier resources.

resource_type values: postgres, redis, mongodb, queue, stack

### GET /api/v1/resources/:id

Get a single resource by UUID.

Response 200:
  { "ok": true, "item": { "id": "...", "token": "...", "resource_type": "postgres", "tier": "hobby", "status": "active", "created_at": "...", "storage_exceeded": false } }

- storage_exceeded: boolean, only present on resources with storage (postgres, nosql, queue). True when the resource has exceeded its plan storage limit; writes may be blocked.

Response 403: resource belongs to different team.
Response 404: not found.

### DELETE /api/v1/resources/:id

Soft-delete a resource. Token is deactivated immediately.

Response 200:
  { "ok": true, "message": "Resource deleted" }

---

## Tiers

| Tier      | Cost       | Postgres         | Redis     | MongoDB           | Stacks    | Resource lifetime |
|-----------|------------|------------------|-----------|-------------------|-----------|-------------------|
| anonymous | free       | 10MB / 2 conn    | 5MB       | 5MB / 2 conn      | 1 active  | 24 hours          |
| hobby     | $9/month   | 500MB / 5 conn   | 25MB      | 100MB / 5 conn    | 3 active  | permanent         |
| pro       | $49/month  | 5120MB / 20 conn | 256MB     | 2048MB / 20 conn  | 10 active | permanent         |
| team      | $199/month | unlimited        | unlimited | unlimited         | unlimited | permanent         |

Anonymous provision limit: 5 provisions per day (per network).
At the provision limit, existing token is returned (fail-open, not 429).

---

## Error Shape

All errors:
```json
{
  "ok": false,
  "error": "error_code",
  "message": "Human-readable description"
}
```

Common codes: rate_limit_exceeded (429), invalid_token (400/401), not_found (404), expired (410),
already_claimed (409), service_disabled (503), provision_failed (503), unauthorized (401),
forbidden (403), invalid_body (400), missing_token (400), build_failed (503), stack_not_found (404).

---

## Response Headers

| Header             | When set              | Description |
|--------------------|-----------------------|-------------|
| X-Instant-Notice   | Near/at resource limit | e.g. "Approaching daily limit. Upgrade for more." |
| X-Instant-Upgrade  | Upgrade URL available | Absolute URL to /start?t=... |
| X-Request-ID       | Always                | Unique request ID for support |
